plan.title: Mouse liver HFD vs chow: DE + hallmark GSEA
plan.analytical_narrative:
The input is a single 12000 x 13 gene-level Salmon count matrix (counts.csv, mouse gene symbols in the first column) plus a 12 x 2 sample table (metadata.csv) describing 6 high-fat-diet vs 6 chow mice, unpaired, one batch. The research question has two parts (which genes change, which hallmark pathways change) and one explicit data concern (sample_01 has a library size ~4x below the median).

Step T1S1 handles the concern head-on rather than deleting the sample: library sizes and detected-gene counts per sample, blind VST, PCA on the 500 most variable genes, and a sample-distance heatmap, all coloured by condition, with sample_01 labelled. DESeq2 median-of-ratios size factors already down-weight a shallow library, so depth alone is not a reason to drop it; the step outputs an explicit keep/drop recommendation with a stated reason, and a decision to drop must be justified by position on the PCA/distance heatmap or an identity problem, not by depth. T1S2 is the primary inference: minimal pre-filter (>=10 counts in >=6 samples, the smallest group size), ~condition with chow set explicitly as the reference level so a positive log2FC means higher in HFD, DESeq2 Wald test, apeglm shrinkage for ranking and plots, BH with independent filtering at alpha 0.05, and the raw p-value histogram inspected before trusting the adjustment. Because n=6 per group sits at the low end and the counts come from Salmon without transcript-length offsets (only a summarized gene-level matrix was provided), T1S3 re-runs the same contrast with the edgeR quasi-likelihood F-test and reports the intersection as the high-confidence gene set — the disagreement between the two tools is the honest measure of how much the shallow sample and the replicate count cost.

T2S1 answers the pathway half with fgsea preranked GSEA on the full tested gene list ranked by the DESeq2 Wald statistic (the disputed ranking choice is resolved to the Wald stat: it is signed and scaled by its own standard error, unlike the unshrunken fold change), against the mouse hallmark collection — the curated murine ortholog mapping, not a human collection with an ad-hoc symbol map. HFD liver is expected to move lipid/fatty-acid-metabolism, bile-acid, xenobiotic and inflammatory hallmarks; that expectation is a prior to check the result against, not a conclusion. T1S4 assembles the report with MA and dispersion plots, both shrunken and unshrunken effect sizes, leading-edge genes per significant hallmark, and a full reproducibility record.

steps.method: Sample structure QC: blind VST, PCA on top 500 variable genes, sample distance heatmap, library sizes
Keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples
~ condition with control as explicit reference level
fgsea preranked GSEA on the DESeq2 Wald statistic against MSigDB mouse hallmark
Reproducible report: MA plot, dispersion plot, gene table with shrunken and unshrunken LFC, leading edge genes, DESeq2/edgeR overlap, sessionInfo

steps.description: Take the complete tested-gene table from T1S2 (every gene with a Wald statistic, not a significance-filtered subset) and rank all genes by the DESeq2 Wald statistic, descending. Resolve the mouse hallmark gene set collection from the environment's reference store — the murine hallmark GMT keyed on MGI gene symbols, which matches the identifier space of the count matrix, so no ortholog mapping is required. Restrict each set to genes present in the ranked list and keep sets with 15 to 500 members after that intersection. Run fgsea with a fixed random seed and BH adjustment. Report normalized enrichment score, p-value, padj and set size for every hallmark; collapse redundant significant sets (fgsea collapsePathways) and report one representative per group with the full table kept as a supplement. Report the share of tested genes that matched at least one hallmark set and the share of hallmark genes absent from the tested list. Record the collection name and version alongside the results.
steps.context: Mouse liver, high-fat diet vs chow. The reference store currently holds an MSigDB mouse hallmark collection (2026.1) with MGI symbols; the count matrix is already keyed on mouse gene symbols, so this is a direct match. Ranking metric is a disputed choice — this plan chooses the DESeq2 Wald statistic, because it is signed and scaled by its own standard error and so does not put noisy low-count genes at the extremes, unlike the unshrunken log2 fold change, and does not create ties the way a signed p-value does at saturation.
acceptance_criteria: The GSEA input is the full ranked list of every tested gene from T1S2, with no significance cutoff applied first
The ranking metric is the DESeq2 Wald statistic and this choice is stated in the output
The mouse hallmark collection is used, resolved from the reference store, with its name and version recorded; a human collection with an ad-hoc symbol map is not used
Gene sets are restricted to 15-500 members after intersecting with the tested genes, and the window is reported
A results table gives NES, p-value, padj and size for every hallmark set, with significant sets at padj < 0.05 named and their direction stated
Redundant significant sets are collapsed and one representative per group is reported, with the full table kept as a supplement
The share of tested genes mapping into the collection is reported
A fixed random seed is set and recorded
constraints: Ranked-list GSEA on the full tested list; do not threshold the list before the test and do not substitute an over-representation test
Rank by the Wald statistic (stat); not by the unshrunken log2 fold change alone and not by a signed p-value
Mouse hallmark collection only — do not map mouse symbols onto a human collection
min_size = 15, max_size = 500 applied after intersection with the tested genes
Collapse redundant sets before reporting; keep the full table as a supplement
Set and record a random seed for the permutation-based p-values
Report the version of the gene set collection with the results
caveats: If the mouse hallmark collection is absent from the reference store at run time, do not silently substitute the human hallmark collection: report the absence, and only as a fallback map mouse symbols to human via one-to-one babelgene orthologs, reporting the mapped, many-to-many and unmapped shares

Fewer than ~50 genes at padj < 0.05 would make an over-representation test powerless — the ranked method is used here precisely so that a weak but coordinated shift is still detectable; state the size of the significant gene list in the output
Enrichment results are method-dependent: a hallmark hit is a hypothesis for follow-up, not a proven mechanism
Gene length and expression level bias enrichment on count data; the universe is the tested genes, which removes the detection part of that bias

grounding.reason: Mouse dataset with a ranked-list question: fgsea preranked on the full tested list against the curated mouse hallmark collection per R-0049/R-0107; the disputed ranking metric (R-0108) is resolved to the DESeq2 Wald statistic per R-0099.

steps.name: Consolidated DE and pathway report
steps.question: What is the reproducible, fully documented answer to which genes and which hallmark pathways change between high-fat-diet and chow mouse liver, and how much confidence does the shallow sample_01 and n=6 per group permit?
steps.description: Assemble the results of T1S1, T1S2, T1S3 and T2S1 into one report. Open with the method, package versions, the design formula ~condition, the named contrast and its direction, the thresholds, the number of genes tested after filtering out of 12000, and the number of DE genes. Include the MA plot and the dispersion plot before the gene tables, and say what each shows. Gene table: unshrunken log2FoldChange, apeglm-shrunken log2FoldChange, lfcSE, stat, pvalue and padj, ranked by the shrunken value, with the shrinkage estimator named in the header. State the DESeq2/edgeR intersection as the high-confidence set. Pathway section: the collapsed hallmark results with NES and padj, and the leading-edge genes of each significant set with their gene-level statistics, marking leading-edge overlap between reported sets. Carry the sample_01 verdict from T1S1 forward explicitly, including its library size and detected genes and whether it was kept. Close with a reproducibility record: sessionInfo, the random seed, package versions, the gene set collection version, and a statement that the counts arrived already summarized to gene level so no transcript-length offsets were applied.
steps.context: This is the deliverable that answers both halves of the research question. It must not overstate: 6 vs 6 mice with one shallow library supports a ranked hypothesis list and coordinated pathway shifts, not mechanistic claims.
acceptance_criteria: The report names the method, package versions, design formula, contrast and its direction, thresholds, number of genes tested and number of DE genes before the gene tables
MA plot and dispersion plot appear before the gene tables, each with a stated interpretation
The gene table carries both unshrunken and shrunken log2 fold changes plus lfcSE, ranked by the shrunken value, with apeglm named
The DESeq2/edgeR intersection is reported as the high-confidence gene set
Leading-edge genes are listed for each significant hallmark set with their gene-level statistics, and overlap between reported sets is marked
The gene set database, its version, the ranking metric (Wald statistic), the universe (tested genes) and the size window are all stated
The sample_01 library size, detected-gene count and keep/drop verdict are restated in the report
A reproducibility record with sessionInfo, seed, package versions and collection version is stored with the results
The report states that enrichment results are method-dependent and presents hallmark hits as hypotheses
constraints: Report both effect-size columns; never rank genes by the unshrunken log2 fold change alone
Include the MA plot and the dispersion plot as the two fit diagnostics
State the enrichment database, version, ranking metric, universe and size window
Include the leading-edge gene list per significant set
Store the reproducibility record with the results, not separately
Do not claim mechanism from a pathway hit; label hallmark results as hypotheses for follow-up
caveats: Enrichment methods disagree with one another; name the method and do not present one result as the truth
With 6 mice per group and one library ~4x shallow, the study is modestly powered — say so plainly rather than implying a definitive gene list

grounding.reason: Report content follows the returned report-step rules: both effect columns and shrunken ranking (R-0085), MA and dispersion diagnostics (R-0087), full method/version/threshold disclosure (R-0041/R-0051), leading edge per set (R-0105), method-dependence caveat (R-0055) and a reproducibility record (R-0086).
